erin (customer): Hey team — we've been seeing a sharp p99 increase for /v1/generate on model m-l1 since ~06:10 UTC. Users reporting timeouts.

dave (support): Thanks Erin. Can you paste the request id(s) or a curl we can repro? Also any API errors?

erin (customer): request id 2026-06-11-09a7c3, example curl: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer XXX\" -d '{\"model\":\"m-l1\",\"prompt\":\"long sequence\",\"max_tokens\":512}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` — no 500s, just huge latency (p99 ~1.2s, baseline ~240ms).

alice (sre): Noted. I'm pulling infra traces. dave, can you run quick repro and attach a kernel selection log? We suspect attention kernel change.

dave (support): Repro attached: small log snippet from runtime (trimmed):

```
[2026-06-11T06:11:02Z] request_id=2026-06-11-09a7c3 model=m-l1 seq_len=512 selected_kernel=SDPA_fused_v2 compile_flags=\"-O3 -ffast-math -march=native\"
[2026-06-11T06:11:02Z] request_id=2026-06-11-09a7c3 p50=30ms p95=420ms p99=1180ms
[2026-06-11T06:11:02Z] workspace=us-west-2 node=gpu-17 kernel_latency_ms=1150
```

ben (runtime-dev): Hmm SDPA_fused_v2 was enabled in the last build (CI #5482) to try a new AVX512-friendly path. That compile introduces different vectorization and seems to regress for large batch/seq combos on Ampere.

carol (ml-eng): We toggled FlashAttention vs SDPA last week for throughput. Is there a kernel fallback enabled?

ben (runtime-dev): There is a fallback but it only triggers on kernel failures, not on perf regressions. We can force a kernel selection override per-model via admin flag. Quick mitigation: force `kernel_override=flashattn_safe` for m-l1 while we investigate.

alice (sre): Can you push that override? I'll run canary traffic.

ben (runtime-dev): Pushing override now via internal API: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.example/internal/v1/config \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer internal-token\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"m-l1\",\"kernel_override\":\"flashattn_safe\",\"reason\":\"p99 spike 2026-06-11\"}'
```

deploy-bot: config change applied to pool gpu-*/m-l1 by ben at 2026-06-11T06:14:05Z :rocket:

alice (sre): Canary started. Re-running same curl from Erin.

dave (support): Canary results after override: p99 dropped to ~260ms, p95 ~120ms. Interim fix looks good.

erin (customer): Confirming latency improved for my users. Thanks! :thumbsup:

ben (runtime-dev): Root cause analysis notes so far: CI #5482 added SDPA_fused_v2 with aggressive -ffast-math and inline heuristics. On Ampere cards with sequence=512 and certain kernel launch params it increases L1 pressure causing serialized memory stalls — manifests as p99 regressions under some request mixes.

carol (ml-eng): Repro steps we used: run bench script on gpu-17 with command:
```
python bench_attention.py --model m-l1 --seq 512 --batch 1 --runs 200 --kernels SDPA_fused_v2,flashattn_safe
```
Output shows SDPA_fused_v2 median slightly better but p99 much worse and several 1.0s spikes.

ben (runtime-dev): Action items:
- short-term: keep `kernel_override=flashattn_safe` on m-l1 (owner: ben, done).
- medium: add perf-based fallback threshold (if kernel p99 > baseline * 3 over sliding window) to prefer fallback kernels (owner: ben/alice, ETA 4h).
- long-term: revert aggressive compile flags in CI and run broader hardware perf matrix (owner: carol, ETA 2d).

alice (sre): I'm adding alert rule: `p99_latency_model_m-l1 > 400ms for 5m` -> pager for eng-runtime.

ben (runtime-dev): Also adding a per-model kernel toggle in Console (quick UI) so product/support can flip without internal API. I'll open PR and patch the runtime to emit `kernel_perf_metrics` per-req so we can auto-detect regressions.

dave (support): Will update customer with mitigation and ETA for full fix.

erin (customer): Appreciate the fast response. Please tag me on the status update.

ben (runtime-dev): Tagging done. Will post PR link and canary results here when ready.

alice (sre): Closing loop: canary stable at +30m, plan to roll override to all regions at 07:00 UTC unless regressions reappear.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled for 2026-06-11T07:00:00Z by alice to regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1.

ben (runtime-dev): Final note: avoid `-ffast-math` for attention kernels until we validate numerics/perf on all supported GPUs.

carol (ml-eng): Filing follow-up JIRA: INF-3124 "SDPA compile flags perf regression & kernel fallback" (link forthcoming).

alice (sre): Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the source of truth for rollback/metrics.
